commission: Create a deterministic function that turns verified attention-worthy states into alarming, impossible-to-skim notification text whose notification alone contains the complete action; resolved conditions must stop notifying.

inScope: Deterministic variation keyed by event id/state/pulse
Contract tests for Gmail, Home Center CI, phone-disconnect, and resolved-state behavior

research: AGENTS.md and AGENTS.base.md require mission preservation, repository truth, Regnet QA, and Venice stop review.
The repository explicitly treats the Android persistent notification as a delivery/control surface.
tools/run_regression_tests.sh is the project-native deterministic regression harness.
Fresh Gmail evidence showed the repeated return-to-work check reminder had become stale after a reply arrived.
Fresh GitHub evidence showed Build Android and Home Center CI both failing on main, demonstrating another legitimate attention target.

selectedJudgmentJars.reason: Keep the slice to a compiler rather than silently installing monitoring or transport.
Notification text must report caller-supplied verified state; implementation claims require repository evidence.
Use a small new module/test plus one regression-harness line group.
Prevent stale alarms from persisting after the underlying condition changes.

antagonism: Alarm fatigue: repeated unresolved events must vary deterministically via an explicit pulse, never randomness.
False urgency: the compiler must not infer facts; it only formats caller-supplied fact/action/state.
Notification truncation: action must precede fact and theatrical sting, and overlong action/fact inputs must fail validation rather than silently lose the command.
Stale reminder: resolved state must return null so a caller cannot legitimately keep emitting the old alert from the same state record.
Body dependence: no required information may exist only in message body text.
reviewerProvenance: ChatGPT GPT-5.6 Sol, separate adversarial Judgment-Jar pass
